notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Arbor Elf.
Arbor Elf does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Arbor Elf, tapping it to untap itself.
Illusionist's Bracer's triggers, copying the Arbor Elf trigger.
Resolve the first Arbor Elf trigger, untapping itself.
Activate Arbor Elf, tapping it to add {G}.
Resolve the second Arbor Elf trigger, untapping itself.
Repeat.
